title: Moss and the Paw Prints
checkpoint: Year 1 Autumn 1, week 3 — School readiness — Phase 5: new sounds ue, aw, tch

pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog digging at the edge of a neat green lawn.

pages.text: Moss gets up and trots off.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog trotting away across the lawn.

pages.text: Moss can not spot the den.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog standing still, looking around worriedly for his den.

pages.text: Moss looks down at the grass.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog peering down closely at the grass underfoot.

pages.text: Moss spots paw prints in the mud.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog noticing small paw prints pressed into a patch of mud.
Close view of the small paw prints, matching Moss the hedgehog's own paw.

pages.text: Moss can draw a mark with his paw, too.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog pressing his paw into the mud to make a matching mark.
Moss the hedgehog comparing his own paw print with the ones in the mud.

pages.text: The prints lead back to the den.
pages.illustration: A line of small paw prints leading back across the lawn towards a den.

pages.text: Moss gets back to the den at last.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog arriving happily back at his den.
